question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Her ribs were _________ but no longer painful.
solution:
The correct answer is "**sore**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sentence suggests that the person's ribs were previously in pain but are no longer hurting.**
 
• The past tense "were" indicates that the pain has already subsided.
 
• Among the given options, the correct word to use is "Sore."
 
 
• **"Sore" means experiencing pain or discomfort.** (पीड़ादायक)
 
 
• Example: He was sore from the long ride.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be: 
 
 
• Her ribs were sore __ but no longer painful.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) "Soar" means to fly upward or rise rapidly. It is not the correct word to use in this context. (ऊंची उड़ान भरना)
 
• Option 3) "Sour" means having an acidic or sharp taste, or having a bad attitude. It does not fit in this sentence. (खट्टा)
 
• Option 4) "Sure" means certain or confident, and it is not the correct word to use in this context.(ज़रूर)
